title: Live feed status
description: Health of the live feed itself.

$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema for this document.

version.description: Major version of this document's format. Fields are only added within a version.

last_run_at.description: When the last scheduled run finished. ISO 8601, UTC.

run_duration_ms.description: How long the last run took.

seconds_since_last_run.description: Age of the last run when this response was served.

stale.description: True if the last run is older than three intervals: the feed may have stopped.

endpoints_checked.description: Endpoints checked in the last run.

endpoint_list_source.description: Where the endpoint list came from.

ok.description: True if the last run had no errors.

items.description: Information that is not an error, such as endpoints left for a later run.
